answer: Each bonded identity is a vertex in the evidence graph: when k identities coordinate equivocation, verified pairwise links expose up to k(k−1)/2 culpable pairs, so the penalty scales as O(k²), not as isolated per-account fines. A trellis of shared messages or timing can establish coordination; splitting stake across a meadow of aliases does not erase those links. On detection, the protocol applies an exponential multiplier to collateral loss, making a sybil swarm increasingly costly to control.
